sources.title: MossAD Demo - MOSS Image Danbooru/E621 57 Artist Style Finetune
sources.snippet: I. Introduction MossAD-Demo (Moss Anime Diffusion) is a Danbooru/Gelbooru/E621 proof of concept Full-Finetune of OpenMOSS's MOSS-Image Base 5B T2I model, trained on a small curated 3,685 images dataset of 57 artists, as a way to test how fast and how well MOSS-Image learns artist styles, booru tags prompting and layout (bounding box) prompting before committing to a much bigger run.
